content.title: Koyo 6205-ZZ Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 25mm Bore x 52mm OD x 15mm Width, Metal Shielded
content.short_description: Koyo 6205-ZZ deep groove ball bearing with metal shields, 25 mm bore, 52 mm OD, 15 mm width, steel cage, dynamic load rating 14.8 kN.
content.long_description:
The Koyo 6205-ZZ is a single-row deep groove ball bearing with a steel cage and ZZ metal shields on both sides. The shields provide a physical barrier against dust and debris ingress while retaining lubricant within the bearing cavity, without contacting the inner race, which keeps friction low compared to contact-seal designs.

Dimensionally the bearing measures 25 mm bore diameter, 52 mm outer diameter, and 15 mm width, corresponding to the standard 6205 series envelope. It carries a dynamic load rating (C) of 14.8 kN and a static load rating (C0) of 7.8 kN, values used to calculate expected service life under rotating loads and to verify capacity for static or shock loading conditions respectively.

This bearing type is used in general industrial rotating equipment such as electric motors, pumps, gearboxes, and conveyor rollers where the 6205 envelope size is specified and metal-shielded protection is sufficient for the operating environment. Confirm shaft and housing fit tolerances, operating speed, and load direction against the C and C0 ratings before installation.
